rationale: This mutation closes the -$10,999 cash deficit by expanding land to a 16–18 plot ceiling synchronized with workforce scaling to 11 hands by Day 13, eliminating the labor underutilization and acreage bottleneck that capped late-game compounding. It integrates fertilizer application directly into the farm execution pipeline immediately following harvest shed deposits while keeping in-situ watering active to prevent dry-interval growth pauses and avoid bag-capacity deadlocks. Finally, it institutes a two-stage dynamic liquidation regime (>=0.85x base Days 1–8, >=0.92x base Days 9–28 with shed relief, and a complete terminal sweep on Day 30), purges phantom wheat reserves when livestock is zero, and enforces strict seed phase-gates to protect margins and eliminate stranded capital.
